description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is Suzuki OEM Door Panel Kit (This is the style currently in production).
You Get It All With This Kit!
Along with the Door Panels you also get the Door Pulls, Door Handle, Handle Bezels, Rear Pulls, Window Cranks & Escutcheons, Door Stop Straps & Covers, Door Panel Clips & Lock Relocation Kit.
These parts do BOTH doors LH & RH.
This is everything you need to completely renew the appearance of your doors.
Has Attachment Clip Slots Pre-Cut into the Back of the Panel.
Has all Required Openings Pre-Cut to Accept the Door Bezels, Door Pulls, Regulator Handles and Limit Straps.
Made from Gray Vinyl over Hardboard.
Comes With Attachment Clips!
NOTE: This kit moves the lock to the top of the door.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Door Panels (Dark Gray)
Qty 2 – Door Pulls /Screws
Qty 2 – Door Handles / Screws
Qty 2 – Handle Bezels / Screws
Qty 2 – Window Cranks & Escutcheons (Includes retainer clips)
Qty 2 – Door Stop Straps & Covers / Screws
Qty 22 – Door Panel Clips (11 Per Door Panel)
Qty 2 – Lock Pulls
Qty 2 – Lock Pull Grommets
Qty 1 – Lock Rod (LH)
Qty 1 – Lock Rod (RH)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1993 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
